existing_overlap: New term article. ai-term-text-to-video covers video generation as a task and already notes that visual coherence is not a physics simulator; this article links to it and only explains what makes an interactive world model different (each frame responds to the latest action). Reinforcement-learning basics are left to ai-term-reinforcement-learning (same batch). AGI definitions are left to ai-term-agi.
notes: Three usages separated per the assignment: RL environment model (Sutton & Barto definition, Ha & Schmidhuber, Dreamer/DreamerV3), LeCun's JEPA route (2022 position paper plus V-JEPA 2 as one follow-up experiment), and generative interactive environments (Genie paper and Genie 3 official post, OpenAI report as a second developer using 'world simulator'). The LLM debate cites Othello-GPT and Gurnee & Tegmark for, Vafa et al. against. The robot-vacuum walkthrough is an illustrative example, labelled as such and not tested. Genie 3 frame rate and resolution are public but left out as product specs. Read but cut for length: Genie 2 official post, Nanda et al. arXiv:2309.00941, MuZero arXiv:1911.08265, I-JEPA arXiv:2301.08243. No model scores, prices or AGI timelines.
